questions.prompt: The 2015–16 Warriors made a record 1,077 threes. What share came from Stephen Curry and Klay Thompson? Nearest whole percent.
questions.context: Golden State · 2015–16 · Curry and Thompson's threes ÷ team threes
questions.note: 678 of them, breaking the duo's own record of 525 from a year earlier.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: a record they broke the following season with 525 and again in the 2015–16 season with 678
source.derivation: Curry and Thompson 678 ÷ Warriors 1,077 × 100 = 62.95, rounded to 63%.

funFacts.text: A season earlier, in 2014–15, Curry and Thompson had combined for 525 threes.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the two combined to make 525 threes

funFacts.text: Golden State also led the league in scoring, three-point percentage and assists that season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: led the league in scoring (114.9 points), field goal percentage (.487), three-point percentage (.416), assists (28.9)

funFacts.text: Golden State became the first team to reach 1,000 threes in a season during a 136–111 win.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
